CustomField.description: On an extra item (one with Primary Checklist Item filled in), the status last copied from its original item when staff accepted or returned it. Set by Record-Trigger: Document Checklist Item After Save together with Status. The validation rule Status Edit Only Through Primary Item uses it to stop staff accepting or returning an extra item by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically from the original item's status. Do not change.
CustomField.label: Primary Item Status
